title: Coven automation definition (coven.automations.definition.v1)
description: A durable, Coven-owned routine definition. Mirrors the wire form the scheduler, ledger, and conformance plane consume. Definitions are the source of truth for identity and lifecycle; execution state lives in the occurrence ledger. The canonical form refuses unknown fields (fail-closed normalization); see conformance vectors under vectors/definitions/.

id.description: Stable identifier; the ledger and scheduler key occurrences by it.

status.description: New definitions default to PAUSED; nothing runs until a human opts in.

rrule.description: Scoped recurrence vocabulary: FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY, optional BYHOUR list (0-23, unique, canonicalized ascending), optional BYDAY list for WEEKLY (MO..SU, canonicalized to two-letter form). Any other key or frequency is refused, never silently downgraded.

timezone.description: utc, local, or an IANA time zone name. utc and IANA names are deterministic; local resolves against the pinned host zone of the certification run.

misfire.description: On recovery only the latest missed occurrence runs; earlier slots are collapsed, never backfilled.

overlap.description: A run is skipped while the previous occurrence of this routine has not settled.

timeoutMinutes.description: Per-run wall-clock timeout. Bounded and required.

outputTarget.description: Atomic output target; delivery lands there only on a completed, verified run.
